title: Cloud agent environment fixes from the retro
body: Implements items from a retro over the last 14 cloud-agent runs. - **Goldens:** `maxDiffPixelRatio: 0.01` → `0.0003` (~100 px mobile, ~300 px desktop), so copy and icon changes now fail. Fixes the paint differences this exposed: two admin CSS-module order races, the Clerk avatar mount, a stray 1 px scroll, the worker index in seeded names, and the join-URL mask width. Restores the filled red `destructive` alert that the shadcn migration replaced. Goldens regenerated in Docker; the hand-maintained golden list is removed from `e2e/README.md`. - **`APPROVAL_POLICY.md`:** deterministic CI evaluation for the PR Approval automation (Actions plus commit-status APIs, subscriptions instead of sleep loops, Bugbot window, dismiss on later failure), content-based risk rules from PR history, and human review routed to the author without reviewer assignment. - **CI:** `Cloud Agent image` workflow builds `.cursor/Dockerfile` when it, `.dockerignore`, `daemon.json` or `environment.json` change. - **Steering:** new `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` (review rules and testing principles); `AGENTS.md` trimmed (lint-backed lines removed, `test.skip` lint rule added, subagent tiers `grok-4.7-high` / `grok-4.7-low` / `claude-sonnet-5-5-high`); six `CLOUD.md` gotchas. Verification: `pnpm test:e2e:docker` green twice in a row (81/81); `pnpm lint`, `pnpm tsc`, `pnpm check:goldens` pass; image build passes locally and fails on the old `.dockerignore`. Review: https://eshqbzbg.vibedrop.site Posted by Cursor [claude-opus-5-5-high]
